families.timeline: Chronological career notes with distinct phases and a separate current remit.
families.interview: Question and first-person answer profile; work, concrete decision and uncertainty are separate answers.
families.evidence_matrix: Capability/evidence/limit rows, with career duration stated outside the matrix.
families.product_brief: Product problem, delivery context, implementation and acceptance narrative.
families.contribution_ledger: Numbered contribution ledger, separating own contribution from team ownership.
families.handover_inventory: Inventory of delivered artifacts, operational instructions and exclusions.
families.engineering_journal: Short journal entries about successive investigation and implementation episodes.
families.decision_record: Decision record: options, choice, consequence, evidence and duration statement.
families.workflow_walkthrough: End-to-end workflow walkthrough: input, processing, failure branch and output.
families.capability_boundary: Can do / done in practice / still unknown profile, written as a capability boundary.
families.milestone_cards: Milestone cards with acceptance evidence and remaining follow-up, not a work chronology.
families.service_retrospective: Retrospective structured around users, constraints, service changes and lessons.

authoring_policy: New source scenarios and professional situations, not variants of the prior sixty CVs or six pilot CVs.
Five profiles per family, one per role; employment/project/internship/contract/unknown planned before text authoring.
Family identity denotes the actual shared writing framework; all five siblings stay together.
No target JD, ranking or desired relevance label is an authoring input. Renderer accepts these assets only.
Each factual skill and duration points to literal authored evidence. Unknown is omitted; role time does not imply technology time.
All families share one AI author/cohort. Disjoint template groups are an operational leakage control, not independent real applicants.

protocol.training: full 50-JD census per train CV; also save random/hard candidate subset for sampling diagnostics
protocol.validation_test: full 50-JD census, fixed before any model scores
protocol.label_target: automatic role/stack/scoped-duration compatibility proxy v3; not verified suitability
protocol.stop: before text scoring, model fitting, validation model selection or test metrics
